about.title: About The Village
about.subtitle: Building stronger school communities through mutual aid and genuine connection
about.missionText1: The Village is a hyperlocal platform designed to strengthen school communities through mutual aid and genuine connection. We empower PTAs, parents, and educators to organize, coordinate, and support each other in the daily work of raising and educating children together.
about.missionText2: Built on the principles of mutual aid, our platform creates spaces where school families help each other as equals—organizing carpools, coordinating classroom supplies, supporting field trips, and building the deep community bonds that help all children thrive.
about.whyMutualAidText1: Mutual aid is voluntary, reciprocal exchange of resources and services for mutual benefit. In school communities, this means parents, educators, and families supporting each other as equals—because we're all in this together.
about.whyMutualAidText2: Instead of relying solely on top-down PTA structures or individual parents burning out, mutual aid creates networks where everyone contributes what they can and receives what they need. The parent organizing carpools today might need a meal train tomorrow. The teacher who shares classroom supplies this month might join a childcare co-op next month.
about.reciprocalDesc: Everyone gives and receives. Room parent today, recipient tomorrow.
about.empoweringDesc: Building resilient school communities that support each other.
about.sustainableDesc: Long-term relationships that last beyond a single school year.
about.schoolCenteredDesc: Organized by school and classroom, so you connect with the families you see every day at drop-off and pick-up.
about.hyperlocalDesc: Built for your immediate school community. Strong support networks start with the people closest to you.
about.privacyFirstDesc: Your data is yours. We don't sell your information, track you across the web, or share details with third parties.
about.parentLedDesc: Built by parents, for parents. Your feedback shapes how this platform grows to serve your community's needs.
about.alwaysFreeDesc: No premium tiers, no hidden fees. School community support should be accessible to every family.
about.leadCompassionDesc: Every family is doing their best. Parenting and supporting schools is hard work—we assume the best intentions and offer grace.
about.celebrateDiversityDesc: All families, backgrounds, identities, abilities, and beliefs are welcome. Our schools are stronger when everyone belongs.
about.communicateClearlyDesc: Be honest, direct, and follow through on your commitments. Reliable communication keeps school communities running smoothly.
about.keepSafeDesc: Respect boundaries, protect privacy, and prioritize safety for all community members, especially children. Safety is non-negotiable.
about.shareGenerouslyDesc: Contribute what you can, when you can. No contribution is too small, and everyone has something to offer the community.
